thesis_statement: Wave-Particle Duality (De Broglie Hypothesis): λ = h/p
parent_thesis: Ampère's Law with Maxwell's Addition: Magnetic fields are generated by electrical currents and time-varying electric fields
formal_proof: p = h / λ. Equates momentum of particles with their corresponding de Broglie wavelength.
context_description: A foundational concept asserting that all matter exhibits both wave and particle properties.

thesis_statement: Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle: Δx * Δp ≥ ℏ/2
parent_thesis: Wave-Particle Duality (De Broglie Hypothesis): λ = h/p
formal_proof: σ_x * σ_p ≥ ℏ / 2. Formally derived from non-commuting operators [x, p] = iℏ in Hilbert space.
context_description: States that the position and momentum of a particle cannot be simultaneously measured with arbitrary precision.

thesis_statement: Schrödinger Equation: iℏ ∂Ψ/∂t = ĤΨ (Time evolution of quantum state)
parent_thesis: Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle: Δx * Δp ≥ ℏ/2
formal_proof: iℏ ∂/∂t |Ψ(t)⟩ = Ĥ |Ψ(t)⟩. Formulates the time evolution of a quantum state in Hilbert space.
context_description: The core equation of quantum mechanics describing how the wave function of a physical system changes over time.

thesis_statement: Born Rule: Probability density of finding a particle at a point is |Ψ|^2
parent_thesis: Schrödinger Equation: iℏ ∂Ψ/∂t = ĤΨ (Time evolution of quantum state)
formal_proof: P(x)dx = |Ψ(x)|^2 dx. Links abstract wave amplitudes to physical probability densities.
context_description: A key postulate of quantum mechanics giving the probability that a measurement on a quantum system will yield a given result.

thesis_statement: Quantum Entanglement (EPR Correlation): Subatomic particles can exist in a shared, non-local quantum state regardless of spatial separation
parent_thesis: Born Rule: Probability density of finding a particle at a point is |Ψ|^2
formal_proof: |Ψ⟩ = (|01⟩ - |10⟩)/sqrt(2). The wave function of the entangled system cannot be factorized into individual particle states.
context_description: Physical phenomenon occurring when pairs or groups of particles are generated or interact such that the quantum state of each particle cannot be described independently.

thesis_statement: Planck's Quantum Postulate: Energy is radiated and absorbed in discrete quanta (E = h*ν)
parent_thesis: Physical Constant Axiom: The physical universe operates according to immutable foundational constants
formal_proof: E = nhν, n ∈ ℕ. Solves the ultraviolet catastrophe of classical blackbody radiation.
context_description: The assertion that energy is quantized, initiating the quantum era.

thesis_statement: Bell's Theorem: No local hidden variable theory can reproduce the predictions of quantum mechanics
parent_thesis: Quantum Entanglement (EPR Correlation): Subatomic particles can exist in a shared, non-local quantum state regardless of spatial separation
formal_proof: |E(a,b) - E(a,c)| ≤ 1 + E(b,c). Proves that local realism is mathematically incompatible with quantum statistics.
context_description: A key theorem showing that quantum mechanics is non-local or violates counterfactual definiteness.
